---
title: "Mocap_trial"
format: html
---

```{r}
remotes::install_github("steenharsted/mocapr")
library(mocapr)
library(tidyverse)

alexia <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Alexia.csv")
View(alexia)
alexia <- alexia |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(alexia$frame)
View(alexia)


bahar <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Bahar.csv")
bahar <- bahar |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(bahar$frame)
View(bahar)

kevin <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Kevin.csv")
kevin <- kevin |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(kevin$frame)
View(kevin)

simon <- import_captury_csv("mocap_02/Simon.csv")
simon<- simon |> filter(!is.na(frame))
tail(simon$frame)
View(simon)


alexia <- alexia |> mutate(skeleton = "Alexia")
bahar  <- bahar  |> mutate(skeleton = "Bahar")
kevin  <- kevin  |> mutate(skeleton = "Kevin")
simon  <- simon  |> mutate(skeleton = "Simon")
all_skel <- bind_rows(alexia, bahar, kevin, simon)
nrow(all_skel)            
count(all_skel, skeleton) 
View(all_skel)
ggplot(all_skel, aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ, colour = skeleton)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal()
ggplot(all_skel, aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton)
ggplot(all_skel, aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ, colour = time_seconds)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()
all_skel |>
  filter(time_seconds < 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = CGX, y = CGZ, colour = time_seconds)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()
names(all_skel)
pair_KB <- inner_join(
  kevin |> select(frame, time_seconds, leader_x = CGX, leader_z = CGZ),
  bahar |> select(frame, follower_x = CGX, follower_z = CGZ),
  by = "frame"
)
pair_KB <- pair_KB |>
  mutate(distance_m = sqrt((leader_x - follower_x)^2 +
                           (leader_z - follower_z)^2) / 1000)
  ggplot(pair_KB, aes(time_seconds, distance_m)) +
  geom_line()


pair_KB |>
  mutate(kevin_earlier_x = lag(leader_x, 50),
         kevin_earlier_z = lag(leader_z, 50)) |>
  summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((kevin_earlier_x - follower_x)^2 +
                                   (kevin_earlier_z - follower_z)^2),
                              na.rm = TRUE) / 1000)

delays <- 0:150   

gap_by_delay <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_KB |>
    mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d), lz = lag(leader_z, d)) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

ggplot(gap_by_delay, aes(delay_s, mean_gap_m)) +
  geom_line()

gap_by_delay |> slice_min(mean_gap_m)

gap_by_delay |> filter(delay_s == 0)

gap_window <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_KB |>
    mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d),
           lz = lag(leader_z, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()
best_KB <- gap_window |>
  group_by(window) |>
  slice_min(mean_gap_m)

ggplot(best_KB, aes(window, delay_s)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)")

ggplot(best_KB, aes(window, delay_s)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_gap_m)) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)", size = "Gap (m)")

best_KB <- best_KB |> filter(window < 120)

###
pair_AS <- inner_join(
  alexia|> select(frame, time_seconds, leader_x = CGX, leader_z = CGZ),
  simon |> select(frame, follower_x = CGX, follower_z = CGZ),
  by = "frame"
)
pair_AS <- pair_AS |>
  mutate(distance_m = sqrt((leader_x - follower_x)^2 +
                           (leader_z - follower_z)^2) / 1000)
  ggplot(pair_AS, aes(time_seconds, distance_m)) +
  geom_line()


pair_AS |>
  mutate(alexia_earlier_x = lag(leader_x, 50),
         alexia_earlier_z = lag(leader_z, 50)) |>
  summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((alexia_earlier_x - follower_x)^2 +
                                   (alexia_earlier_z - follower_z)^2),
                              na.rm = TRUE) / 1000)

delays <- 0:500   

gap_by_delay <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_AS |>
    mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d), lz = lag(leader_z, d)) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

ggplot(gap_by_delay, aes(delay_s, mean_gap_m)) +
  geom_line()

gap_by_delay |> slice_min(mean_gap_m)

gap_by_delay |> filter(delay_s == 0)

gap_window <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_AS |>
    mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d),
           lz = lag(leader_z, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()
best_AS <- gap_window |>
  group_by(window) |>
  slice_min(mean_gap_m)

ggplot(best_AS, aes(window, delay_s)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)")

ggplot(best_AS, aes(window, delay_s)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_gap_m)) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)", size = "Gap (m)")

best_AS <- best_AS |> filter(window < 120)

both <- bind_rows(
  best_KB |> mutate(pair = "Kevin → Bahar"),
  best_AS |> mutate(pair = "Alexia → Simon")
) |>
  filter(window < 120)

ggplot(both, aes(window, delay_s, colour = pair)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_gap_m)) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)", size = "Gap (m)", colour = NULL)

delays <- 0:300

gap_window_KB <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_KB |>
    mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d), lz = lag(leader_z, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

best_KB <- gap_window_KB |> group_by(window) |> slice_min(mean_gap_m)

delays <- 0:300

gap_window_AS <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_AS |>
    mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d), lz = lag(leader_z, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

best_AS <- gap_window_AS |> group_by(window) |> slice_min(mean_gap_m)

head(best_KB)
head(best_AS)

both <- both |>
  mutate(following = mean_gap_m < 0.5 & delay_s > 0 & delay_s < 6)

ggplot(both, aes(window, delay_s, colour = pair)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(both, following)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = following), size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)", colour = NULL,
       shape = "Following?")
  
  qom <- all_skel |>
  group_by(skeleton) |>
  arrange(frame, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(step_mm  = sqrt((CGX - lag(CGX))^2 + (CGZ - lag(CGZ))^2),
         speed_ms = step_mm / 1000 * 50) |>
  ungroup()

qom_window <- qom |>
  mutate(window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
  group_by(skeleton, window) |>
  summarise(mean_speed = mean(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(window < 120)
ggplot(qom_window, aes(window, mean_speed, colour = skeleton)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean speed (m/s)", colour = NULL)

speed_wide <- qom |>
  select(skeleton, frame, time_seconds, speed_ms) |>
  group_by(skeleton) |>
  mutate(speed_smooth = as.numeric(stats::filter(speed_ms, rep(1/25, 25), sides = 2))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-speed_ms) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = skeleton, values_from = speed_smooth)

delays <- 0:300

cc_KB <- map(delays, \(d)
  speed_wide |>
    mutate(leader = lag(Kevin, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(r = cor(leader, Bahar, use = "complete.obs")) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

cc_AS <- map(delays, \(d)
  speed_wide |>
    mutate(leader = lag(Alexia, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(r = cor(leader, Simon, use = "complete.obs")) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

best_cc_KB <- cc_KB |>
  group_by(window) |>
  slice_max(r) |>
  filter(window < 120)

best_cc_AS <- cc_AS |>
  group_by(window) |>
  slice_max(r) |>
  filter(window < 120)

both_cc <- bind_rows(
  best_cc_KB |> mutate(pair = "Kevin → Bahar"),
  best_cc_AS |> mutate(pair = "Alexia → Simon")
)

ggplot(both_cc, aes(window, r, colour = pair)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = delay_s)) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Speed correlation (r)",
       size = "Delay (s)", colour = NULL)
 shift <- function(x, d) if (d >= 0) lag(x, d) else lead(x, -d)
 
 delays <- -300:300

gap_window_AS2 <- map(delays, \(d)
  pair_AS |>
    mutate(lx = shift(leader_x, d), lz = shift(leader_z, d),
           window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
    group_by(window) |>
    summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                     (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) |>
    mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
) |> list_rbind()

best_AS2 <- gap_window_AS2 |>
  group_by(window) |>
  slice_min(mean_gap_m) |>
  filter(window > 0, window < 120)
ggplot(best_AS2, aes(window, delay_s)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_gap_m)) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Simon's delay (s)", size = "Gap (m)")+ geom_vline(xintercept = 45, colour = "red")
```
